title: Juicy Filipino Pork Curry
description: A spicy and tender one-pot Filipino dish featuring green curry paste, served on a wooden board. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the green curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, pasta water, fish sauce, brown sugar, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Arrange the curry on a wooden board for a unique presentation.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
